name: Documentation drift
intent: Find the prose a change just made false, before someone acts on it.

steps.name: Run the examples the documents contain
steps.note: A doctest that is not run is a comment.

steps.name: Update, or record why the document is deliberately behind
Confirm it is findable
steps.note: mix docs builds doc/, which is the prose search index. A spec not in extras is a spec nobody finds.

escalations.when: a document describes a contract the code no longer honours
escalations.note: That is a contract question, not a prose question.

completion: every affected document updated or explicitly deferred with a bead
new pages appear in the index
evaluation: documents found stale by a later reader that this step should have caught
